notes.title: New Demo Update! 1.1
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

We’re excited to bring you the first update to the Frozen Injustice demo! This update focuses on improving the overall experience with:

✅ Polish to the main level – Smoother gameplay, refined visuals, and improved interactions.

✅ Enhanced narrative elements – More immersive storytelling to bring the world of Frozen Injustice to life.

✅ Time Attack Mode – A brand-new way to test your skills and race against the clock!

✅ Quality of Life Improvements – Adjustments based on your feedback for a better experience.

We’re also actively working on bug fixes, which will be rolling out in the short term. Let us know what you think, and keep the feedback coming!

Thanks for playing, and stay tuned for more updates!

notes.title: Demo available!
notes.content:
[h1]The official demo for Frozen Injustice is now live! 🎉[/h1]

You can find it here: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3227000/Frozen_Injustice_Fridge_Adventures_Demo/]Frozen Injustice Demo[/url]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3227000/Frozen_Injustice_Fridge_Adventures_Demo/][img]https://i.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExOWtuNDh4c2lxMWdqZmUzcmJrajI3a3ZjeXNmejg0d25meTdwZnM1YiZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/be3NSTQlnXych6yqPX/giphy.gif[/img][/url]

This demo showcases the gameplay we aim to deliver in the final game, including core mechanics like [b]attacks and jumps[/b].

While the demo doesn’t include story elements or supporting characters yet, we plan to add them soon so you can experience what the final game will be like.

[h2]Remember, we have an active crowdfunding campaign! [url=https://esponsor.com/frozeninjustice/crowdfund/goals/1CBpZobqX16siBCFvoMFQY]Support us here[/url][/h2]

[h3][b]We can’t wait to see your feedback and your best time record! [/b][/h3]
